line_text: Don't worry, lad. I know the watch has been a bit rough today, but things should get back to normal soon enough once the parade is over. / The ceremony's over. You're free to move about Lowtown and pass through the city gates. / Lord Vayne is very particular about the rules he sets out. He's ordered us to treat you commoners proper, like. Of course I would, orders or no! / I'm on watch. If you have no business here, kindly leave me be. I've enough on my mind with Lord Vayne breathing down our necks... / Leave me be, would you? I'm trying to focus on my duties. I've no time for idle gossip. / Isn't Rabanastre marvelous? Fascinating in ways wholly different from Archades. I've even taken to the local fashion! / Under Vayne's rule, Rabanastre will flourish as never before. I'm sure of it! I may even consider moving here myself! / Life is easier in Archades, no question. But Lord Vayne is here in Rabanastre... Should I stay? Should I go? What to do!? / Apparently Vayne's been summoned back to Archades. I'm sure it will only be temporary, though. If not, what reason have I to remain in Rabanastre? Oh, I do hope he comes back soon. / Our Emperor is dead, and Lord Vayne rules as autocrat in his stead. How terrible! If I'd known this was going to happen, I would never have moved to this city! O cruel fate! / Not now, boy, I'm on duty. Peddle your wares elsewhere, eh? / Listen, churl, you get into trouble, do it proper, like. Make a name for yourself. I want the bounty on your head to be worth the trouble! Har! / I hear there's a resistance group planning something against the Imperials. But if you ask me, things aren't so bad the way they are now. / The guards are letting people into Lowtown again, but I still can't find the stairs! My map shows a stairway over by the gambit shop, but I can't make head nor tail of it. / They've sent the worst of the guards back to Archadia. Removed for running afoul of the Consul... I shudder to think what happens to them. / I used to think all the guards were bad, but some of them actually care about the people they're protecting. / The Imperials seem restless. Do you think another war could be on the way? / We're on heightened watch until the Consul's inauguration ceremony is complete. Parts of the city are off limits for the duration. / I was just out for a little stroll and these Imperials yell at me for no reason at all. Is such a heavy guard needed for the consul's arrival? / I can never find my way to Lowtown when I need to. There should be a stairway around here somewhere... / Seems Vayne's ordered the guards to speak to us more proper, like. Trouble is, some of the guards aren't too bright, and it just comes out funny. / Have you noticed the bangaa standing guard in front of the building just to the west of the bridge? I wonder what's inside... / The Imperials have been buying up a lot of provisions lately. I hope they've left enough for the rest of us. / Such a grand city... Why, even the locals must need a map to find their way! Go ahead, look at your map. There's no shame in it! / Such a grand city... Why, even the locals must need a map to find their way! Go ahead, look at your map. There's no shame in it! / Such a grand city... Why, even the locals must need a map to find their way! Go ahead, look at your map. There's no shame in it! / Such a grand city... Why, even the locals must need a map to find their way! You surely know your way around by now, though! / Such a grand city... Why, even the locals must need a map to find their way! You surely know your way around by now, though! / Can't turn around without running into an Imperial today. Times like this, it's best to just keep your head down and stay outta trouble. / I didn't understand a word of that speech, but I'll get Old Dalan to explain it to me. There's no one knows more than he does! / Vaan, is that you? I'm surprised to see you here. All I've heard out of Penelo lately is "Vaan's GONE!" She's been miserable. You should really go see her. / I had no idea Penelo had been kidnapped... And to think, you were off rescuing her! I knew we could always count on you, Vaan! / Seems like you've been keeping pretty busy lately. Penelo's been with you, right? Just make sure you two be careful. We don't want anything to happen to you, okay? / No loitering! Can't keep watch with the likes of you standing 'round. We're under strict orders to arrest suspicious characters, boy. / There are those who care little for the Empire. No doubt they are the reason behind the show of Imperial force today. / So the ceremony ended without incident, eh? Good! I don't care much for the Empire, but I care even less for trouble. / Things have finally settled down 'round here. They've even reopened the aerodrome! Not that I'll be flyin' anywhere... / I keep well away from trouble—haven't the stomach for it. If that makes me a coward, so be it! / Word on the street is that Marquis Ondore has set something big into motion. I wonder what he has hidden up his sleeve? / I haven't the slightest interest in this Imperial parade. It will only remind me of the Princess's wedding to Prince Rasler... I didn't have the clearest view of them then, but I could tell how happy they were. If only things had turned out differently... / Vayne invaded Nalbina... Basch wouldn't accept surrender and killed the King... Enemies of Dalmasca both, in my book. / I've heard the kingslayer is back in Rabanastre. If it's true, I have a choice word or two for him... Though I wonder if I'd even recognize him. / Turns out those rumors about the kingslayer being in Rabanastre were no more than that. A friend visiting Bhujerba told me she saw a kid running around saying he was Basch. Needless to say, he wasn't. / Now people are saying they've seen Princess Ashe alive. But after that Basch impersonator's antics in Bhujerba, I'm not falling for it. I wish she were alive, though... I'm sure she'd be able to help us. / First the parade, then the fete. This consul must be an important man. / The Empire wouldn't send someone like Vayne just anywhere. No, this says something about Dalmasca's importance to the Empire. / The consul may change, but how long will it be before we see change on the streets? Though I'll admit, the guards seem more mannerly now. / The city's prospects have taken a real turn for the better since Vayne became consul. I really underestimated that man. / Vayne is a talented man. I hope that in his absence from Rabanastre he applies those talents toward peaceful ends... / Oh, Vaan, it's you. Even two years later, sometimes I look at you and see Reks. / That new consul—he looks like some kind of general to me. Which means he was probably involved in the attack on Nalbina. Why would they send someone like him to rule us? / I heard the Imperials had caught you for something or other. Glad you gave 'em the slip. I gotta tell ya, I'm surprised you made it out. / I know that look. Reks used to have that same determined fire in his eyes. Whatever you may be thinking, don't do anything stupid, okay, Vaan? You owe it to your brother. / There's a storm coming, Vaan. Can you feel it? The Empire's on the move... / The most important thing in a fight? A level head on your shoulders. Beasts great and small roam abroad. Be sure you know which you face before charging into battle. / I do hope the parade drums up some business. I've just come from the bazaar, but I can scarcely afford a thing. / If I could find a way to curry favor with Lord Vayne, I'd need never worry about money again. / So, the night of the fete, I tried to sneak into the palace to steal a word or two with Lord Vayne. But the guards mistook me for a thief! It was all straightened out quickly enough, but I was furious. Couldn't have happened at a worse time. / Thanks to the work I found in the palace, I can afford to feed my younger brothers, and I even have a few gil left over for myself! / Things have finally started coming together for me since I began working in the palace. I'll keep at it until my brothers can take care of themselves. / They're holding a banquet in the palace after the parade is over. Delicacies and delectables the likes of us'll never taste, boy. / They'll be starting that fete in the palace soon. Ah, the food they'll have... What I wouldn't give for just a taste! / Did you know there's a mine right in the middle of Bhujerba? Hard work, mining, but the pay's tempting, so it is. Bhujerba's run by one Marquis Ondore. Supposed to be a right generous fellow, so maybe the money's as good as they say. / Went off to Giza Plains looking for work, but it turns out it was the Rains. Went all that way and didn't see a soul. / I treated myself to a trip to Archades the other day, but something big must've been happening. The entire city was in a frenzy. / They're locking the city down tight. Which suits me fine. I'm happy to stay right here. Don't believe me? Head down to the gates and see for yourself! / I can finally go home to Lowtown now! Maybe I'll pay Old Dalan a visit. He's always got a tall tale or two to tell. / The Consul's been quite busy with his civic projects, you know. Perhaps Lowtown's fortunes are on the up? / The other day I saw a bright flash in the sky off to the west, and a few hours later some wounded Imperials were brought into town. I wonder what happened out there... / You've heard of the Rozarrian Empire? You don't suppose they'd take advantage of the Emperor's death to attack us, do you?

speaker: Ktjn
line_text: It is so good to see you. You have been very kind to speak freely with me as you have. Not for me is the life of the warrior chosen by my sister. Yet what else I might do instead, I know not. I worry that I may have left the Wood before thinking my actions through. Still, I have met many people. I have heard their stories, told stories of my own. I will continue my search. I would not be here now had you not listened to my troubles. Here, I want you to take this. A small token of my gratitude. / Oh, hello. Today, this place I have chosen to speak and to listen. The town brims with stories waiting to be heard. Much can I learn here that would ever have remained unknown to me in the Wood. / My will I have steeled, and to many new and strange people I have spoken. I know now how much there is I do not know.

Sadly, Giza's candidates were...underwhelming. So I quit those desolate plains, and soon found myself set upon by beasts intent on eating me, humes intent on selling me—barbarians all! Then it all became clear: Chit. She was the one! If she had returned to the plains, then I, too, would go home! / (It seems to be asking you something.) I have made my decision. Between my sister's path and another of my own invention, I have finally chosen. I do not think I could have made my decision without your help. I thank you. line_text: It is so good to see you. You have been very kind to speak freely with me as you have. Not for me is the life of the warrior chosen by my sister. (choices: Accept the hunt. / Decline.) / Now then, where was I? Our orders led us through the Westersand and further west into the sandsea. We'd just arrived at the western edge of the Nam-Yensa Sandsea when we saw it in the sky: the wyvern lord. It didn't worry the others, but it certainly worried me. What if that wyrm were to attack Rabanastre, I thought. I informed the commander of my concerns—he dismissed it as a bad case of nerves, saying even if it did attack, the watch would soon stop it. Most like the city would be safe, I'll give him that, but it doesn't mean there wouldn't be casualties. I may be Archadian, but I care about Rabanastre. That's why I posted this bill against my own purse. It's got naught to do with the Empire. I want you to slay that wyvern lord for me! / That's your prerogative. If you have a change of heart, you know where to find me. / I sighted the wyvern lord beyond the Westersand, in the western reaches of the Nam-Yensa Sandsea. Naught there to see but the rolling waves of the sandsea... Hunt down that beast for me, boy. Don't let me down. / Slain the wyvern lord, have you? You've done Rabanastre a great service, boy. After you'd set out, I thought I might have been overreacting just a touch after all, but there's naught to be gained from doubting now, is there? You've done a man's job. Here's your bounty. Take it with my thanks. / Some weapons are good for range, some strike quickly. Find a weapon that suits your needs, and stick with that. / Some weapons are good for range, some strike quickly. Find a weapon that suits your needs, and stick with that. / There hasn't been any official proclamation yet, but apparently some insurgents staged an assault on the palace the night of the fete. You could hear the commotion all over the city. It quieted down soon enough, though. Maybe it was just part of the night's entertainment? / Can't say as I know for certain it's Lord Vayne's doing, but the guards do seem to be getting on better with people than they used to. You can be sure the guards aren't too pleased by it. I'd hate to be whoever or whatever they're taking their frustrations out on. / If you'd been following the Empire's moves recently, you'd be worried for Rabanastre, too. 'Twixt them and the Resistance, who can say what's a-brewin'... / Sure, we call 'em all "monsters," but not all are created equal. Plenty will keep to their business, if you keep to yours. 'Course, if you go pickin' a fight, don't be surprised if'n they fight back. (snort) / So many weapons, so little gil... / Pish! What about all those pelts and fangs from the monsters you've killed? You know, the loot, kupo! That's worth plenty of gil! / I know, I know. But it seems such a waste to just sell it all... / Nonsense! You're only making things harder for yourself, kupo. Why line your purse with loot, when you could line it with gil instead? But there's more to it than that. The more loot you sell, the more bazaar goods you're like to come across. Do I have to keep selling my loot to the same shop to buy these bazaar goods? / You've got it all wrong, kupo! Where you sell makes no difference. All the shops will have the same bazaar goods available for you. They have a special arrangement, you see, so you can check any shop you like when you want to know which bazaar goods are in stock, kupo! / Hmm. What'll they think of next? / Here's my plan. Once I find some bazaar goods I really like, I'm gonna buy as much as I can. / Oh, no no no. I'm afraid it doesn't work that way, kupo. Once you purchase a bazaar good, it won't be on sale any longer. / What if I sell more loot? If the same bazaar good appears again, I can buy it again, right? / That's right, kupo. If you keep selling the loot you find, the same bazaar goods could come up for sale again. Then, of course, you can buy them again!

speaker: Ma'kenroh
line_text: A new clan member? Hrgm... I am Ma'kenroh. A pleasure, I'm sure. Unlike our other members, I cannot participate in hunts. My specialty lies in the collection of information. If you have a question about one of your marks, ask. I will tell you what I know. / Hello. How does this day find you? / I do all I can for the glory of the clan. Montblanc is an old, dear friend, after all. / Hunting the Rogue Tomato? Hrgm... Find it in the Dalmasca Estersand. Leave by the east gate, head to the northeast. Now, go. / Hunting Thextera? Hrgm... Leave by the west gate, follow the cliff face southward. Now, go. / Hunting the flowering cactoid? Hrgm... Leave by the east gate, traverse the desert until you reach a small village. Continue east. Now, go. / Hunting the wraith? Hrgm... Witnesses place it in the Overflow Cloaca of the Garamsythe Waterway. Now, go. / Hunting the nidhogg? Hrgm... I hear it's somewhere in Transitway 1 of the Lhusu Mines. Now, go. / Hunting the white mousse? Hrgm... I hear whispers that it oozes about the Garamsythe Waterway. Now, go. / Hunting the ring wyrm? Hrgm... It stalks the Windtrace Dunes of the Dalmasca Westersand, but only during sandstorms. Now, go. / Hunting the wyvern lord? Hrgm... It's in the Nam- Yensa Sandsea, the northwest reaches by my guess. Now, go. / Hunting the Marilith? Hrgm... It hides in the portion of the Zertinan Caverns known as the Invitation to Heresy. Now, listen. It is shy of visitors. You must be patient for it to appear. Now, go. / Hunting the enkelados? Hrgm... It's been spotted on Ozmone Plain, in The Shred. Now, listen. Those who saw the enkelados cleared the northern reach of The Shred of a certain monster before it appeared. Now, go. / Hunting the croakadile? Hrgm... Reports of attacks suggest it roams near a bridge on Giza Plains. Now, go. / Hunting Ixtab? Hrgm... Search the Henne Mines. Now, go. / Hunting the feral retriever? Hrgm... The Paramina Rift. The Spine of the Icewyrm is suspicious. Now, go. / Hunting the vorpal bunny? Hrgm... My sources say a vicious bunny was spied in Golmore Jungle. Now, go. / Hunting the mindflayer? Hrgm... I sense its presence in...the Henne Mines. Now, listen. The Phase 1 Dig. Look there. The Mist draws it, remember this. Now, go. / Hunting the bloodwing? Hrgm... Somewhere in the Barheim Passage. You must look for yourself. Now, go. / Hunting the atomos? Hrgm... I sense something in the Mosphoran Highwaste. They are large, it will be somewhere spacious. Now, go. / Hunting the Roblon? Hrgm... Through the fogs of the Nabreus Deadlands, clockwork whirs and clicks. Now, go. / Hunting the Braegh? Hrgm... Through the Salikawood, to the Necrohol of Nabudis...the way is unclear. Now, go. / Hunting the darksteel? Hrgm... Look within the Sochen Cave Palace. Now, go. / Hunting the vyraal? Hrgm... Look on the Cerobi Steppe. Now, go. / Hunting the Lindwyrm? Hrgm... Look in the Tchita Uplands, but not during fair weather. Now, go. / Hunting the overlord? Hrgm... Look in the Sochen Cave Palace. Now, go. / Hunting Goliath? Hrgm... Look in the Necrohol of Nabudis. Now, go. / Hunting the deathscythe? Hrgm... Perhaps the Cloister of the Highborn in the Necrohol of Nabudis? Now, listen. A coward, this. Preys on the weak. Now, go. / Hunting Deathgaze? Hrgm... In the skies. Take the Skyferry, any route should do. Now, go. / Hunting Diabolos? Hrgm... The Lhusu Mines draw my gaze. Now, go. / Hunting the Piscodaemon? Hrgm... I have heard tales, doubtful tales of an ancient city. Now, listen. An ancient city found only in legend... Still, it might exist. Now, go. / Hunting the wild malboro? Hrgm... Look in The Feywood. It will be a hard fight. Now, go. / Hunting the Catoblepas? Hrgm... Look in the Zertinan Caverns. Now, go. / Hunting Fafnir? Hrgm... Look somewhere cold. Now, listen. When the weather worsens, it grows colder. Look then. Now, go. / Hunting the Pylraster? Hrgm... I don't know where to look. Now, listen. The Pylraster is terribly powerful. When you are near, there will be signs. Now, go. / Hunting the cluckatrice? Hrgm... It has been spied along the Gizas North Bank on Giza Plains. Now, listen. The chick will hide while other living things are near. See that they are not. Now, go. / Hunting the rocktoise? Hrgm... Site 2 in the Lhusu Mines is suspicious. Now, go. / Hunting Orthros? Hrgm... Look in the Garamsythe Waterway. Know he has a fondness for young ladies. Now, listen. Orthros takes no notice of men, the lecher. Now, go. / Hunting the gil snapper? Hrgm... Look on Giza Plains, a place called the Tracks of the Beast, when the rains are heavy. Now, go. / Hunting the Trickster? Hrgm... Go to the Frozen Brook in the Paramina Rift. The Trickster is there, though rarely. Now, go. / Hunting the antlion? Hrgm... Deep within Site 9 of the Lhusu Mines, a hard place to reach. Now, go. / Hunting Carrot? Hrgm... Look in the Salikawood. Know that Carrot does not abide the slaying of monsters. Now, go. / Hunting the Ancient Man of Mystery? Hrgm... Look in the Lhusu Mines, atop a bridge...if, indeed, he is still there. Now, go. / Hunting the Behemoth King? Hrgm... Look on plains of snow, the furthest reaches. Slay its kin to draw it out of hiding. Now, go. / Hunting Ixion? Hrgm... Look in the Pharos at Ridorana. Now, go. / Hunting The Seer? Hrgm... Look in the Pharos at Ridorana. Be careful. The Seer fancies itself a god... Now, go. / Hunting Yiazmat? Hrgm... I am sorry. I do not know where it is. Now, listen. Do not approach Yiazmat lightly, should you find the creature. It is more powerful than you can know. Now, go. / Oh, about your clan rank... When you've defeated [value] marks and accumulated [value] clan points, you will gain a rank. Now, go. / You have climbed the clan ranks quickly. I know of no rank higher. Well done. Now, listen. Do not cease your climb. The ranks I do not know...attain them! Now, go. / Incredible. Not even in legend has anyone reached this rank. It is beyond all knowing. Now, listen. To know such a rank exists is itself a wonder. You will live on in song for ages to come. Now, listen. There can be no rank higher. You have attained the pinnacle. Congratulations! Now, go!

speaker: Krjn
line_text: Krjn Yes? What is it you need? I am Krjn, a hunter of Clan Centurio. To know my boundaries did I join the clan. It is a wellspring of information about powerful marks. / Krjn The wind whispered that my sister, Ktjn, had left our village. I did not think she would come here. Not for her is the hunt. Yet Montblanc welcomed her into the clan. Surely she might better serve elsewhere... But come she has, and to me it falls to teach her the skills she will need to survive. Not as my sister, but as my apprentice. A difficult position for me, but I am also glad. Oh my. Do not tell Ktjn we spoke of this. / Krjn The wind whispered that my sister, Ktjn, had left our village. I did not think she would come here. Not for her is the hunt. I sensed reservation within her, so I have assigned to her an apprenticeship as clan watch. Should she show more earnestness, Montblanc may even make her a formal member. Ktjn stands at a crossroads. Though I have my doubts, not with certainty can I say she should shun the hunt. She must choose for herself. A difficult position for me, but I am also glad. Oh my. Do not tell Ktjn we spoke of this. / Krjn Not long ago my sister left the Wood, as I had done before her. I worried for her, but now it seems she's come to Rabanastre. I heard Migelo had taken her in, given her work. Such as would suit her warm nature. She has always dealt well with others, whilst I, have not. Still, she knows little of the world without. No doubt it was all she could do but gape in wonder when first she arrived. Oh my. / Krjn Not long ago my sister left the Wood, as I had done before her. I worried for her, but now it seems she's come to Rabanastre. I heard Migelo had taken her in, given her work. She is learning to cry the shop's wares. I only pray she persists. Either way, she will learn from the experience. She knows so little of the world without... Perhaps through this she will find her path. / Krjn Not long ago my sister left the Wood, as I had done before her. She has come to Rabanastre. She spends her days caring for children, telling them stories of ages past. She has a warm heart, whilst I, have not. Whether she thought fully before making her choice, I cannot say. Viera who leave the Wood may never return. Where will her path lead her next? Viera are long-lived. These choices demand much thought. / Krjn I grow weary of this. Do you go now to hunt this "Carrot"? Let me join you. Unlike a blade, a warrior must fight to keep her edge. Should you contract for the hunt, I will meet you there. / Krjn Carrot fell to the song of our blades and the hymn of our arrows. I excel at woodland combat. I hope you found my presence welcome. I look forward to the next time that I might hone my edge beside you. / Krjn We may someday together hunt a mark, who can say? Should that day come, may we be of aid to each other. / Krjn If you sense danger, be cautious. Flight, too, has its place in battle.

line_text: Monid What are you lookin' at? This ain't no place for children! Him? He's an exception. His parents were both hunters. And they were friends of mine to boot. That is, until they set out on a hunt for this one most notorious mark... But I'll avenge them, be sure of it! I've been keeping an ear to the ground, listening for any sign of that mark ever since. That's what this place is all about. A deadly serious business, this, not to be taken lightly, you hear? / Monid You're not the only one with his sights on the Trickster, boy. If I make it to the petitioner before you, don't let it get you down, eh? / Monid That was a battle to remember! I thought you'd be no more than dead weight, but after seeing you on the field, I know better. I have to admit, you may even be tougher than ol' Monid. Heh. You should be proud. You brought down the Trickster. Today you've earned a place among the best of the best. What's more, you've given this lad's parents the rest they deserve. Them and me both... / Monid Sorry about that business with Ba'Gamnan, usin' ya as bait to lure him out and whatnot. With this behind me, I've had time to think back and realize just how much people here had started to question my motives... line_text: So, here's how it works. People post bills here on the notice board when they have a monster they need taken care of. Headhunters track people, right? Well, hunters track monsters. The monster you're hunting is called your mark. / Here's the bill I posted for the Rogue Tomato, the mark I've petitioned to have hunted. Do you want to hear all the details? (choices: Yeah, that would help. / No, I think I got it.) / Let's start with accepting hunts. You can't just take a look at the board, then go running off to hunt the mark. You'll miss out on the bounty. You gotta talk to the person who posted the bill— the petitioner—first. Let him know you're going on the hunt. So, take this Rogue Tomato bill, for example. I posted it, so I'm the petitioner. You have to come talk to me. Let's call that step "done," okay? Once your agreement's in place, the petitioner will tell you how to find the mark. Then you hunt it, report back, and claim the bounty. Oh, and I'll give you something to help keep track of your hunts: a clan primer. Use it to refresh your memory about hunts you've accepted. / All right, but I'll be expecting you to take care of that Rogue Tomato for me. Oh, and I'll give you something to help keep track of your hunts: a clan primer. Use it to refresh your memory about hunts you've accepted. / Clan Primer has been added to the Party Menu. / Hmm, looks like you can't even equip that yet. Know why? You don't have the license for it. Think of licenses as mile posts, marking your progress as your combat skills improve. Swords, bows, black magicks, white magicks... none of it does you a lick of good until you have the license to use it. Same goes for that armlet. Tomaj, how can I equip this great treasure you've bestowed on me, you ask? Easy: learn by doing. Let's give it a try. / Licenses has been added to the Party Menu. / I'd say you're ready to hunt that mark for me. Oh, you'll be needing this to leave the city. Just show it to the watch at the gate. / The east gate's the one you'll want to head out. Once you've taken care of that mark for me, let me know. Your work won't go unrewarded. / Try equipping the [value]. Use the Licenses command in the Party Menu to obtain the Accessories 1 license, then use the Equip command to equip it. / [WARNING] Once you've chosen a license board, you won't be able to change it right away, so choose wisely! (You'll be able to change boards later in the game.) / Repeat this tutorial message? (choices: No / Yes)

I wish I'd had more time to look around, but it wouldn't do to leave the tavern for too long. So I gave up and decided to post a bill. You get all that? Enter the Zertinan Caverns from the Westersand and find the Marilith. And when you go, go prepared. / Thanks for nothing. I guess that order will have to go unfilled a while longer. But if you're not interested, you're not interested. / Well done! You are here because you defeated the Marilith, aren't you? What? You haven't done it yet? Remember. This is serpentwyne must from the Marilith, no mistake! Now I'll finally be able to deliver on that order of serpentwyne. Migel—er, my customer should be most pleased, most pleased indeed! Very good. Speaking of sky pirates, you should get a look at the fellow up on the balcony. / I heard you could still leave the city through the east gate, but when I tried to pass, I was turned away. I hope they didn't hear that... / Now that the gates are open again, I went to collect some goods, but I, uh, encountered a slight difficulty. Entirely my own fault. I suppose the one has nothing to do with the other, yes? / There are rumors about a strange band of nu mou in the Nabreus Deadlands. Considering the state of the place, I find it hard to believe. / Have you seen how many guards they've stationed in the Southern Plaza? I suppose it makes sense... That is where the city gates are. If you find yourself by Migelo's, you should take a look. Not every day you see that many Imperials in one place. / Never hurts to keep a close eye on the notice board. line_text: You've certainly taken your time, Vaan. I wanted to hear it straight from you, but I already heard through "other" means. Heard what? That you defeated the Rogue Tomato, naturally. I was worried you might not be ready just yet, but you did a fine job of it. Late or not, I suppose you have earned your bounty... Here you go. / Since you did such a good job, I'm gonna let you in on a little something to help you along... Did you ever notice a bangaa standing watch in front of a building in the North End? It might be worth your time to pay him a visit. Show him the clan primer I gave you. He'll let you inside. As for what's there...you'll just have to go see for yourself. / I hear you stopped by the clan hall. You're one shrewd customer. I'm sure you heard all manner of things from the other hunters, but just take your time to ease into it and you'll do fine. / Ah, Vaan! Defeated that Rogue Tomato, did you? I was worried you might not be ready just yet, but you did a fine job of it! Here. Your bounty for completing the hunt. / You followed through on that hunt like a real professional. I'm gonna let you in on a little something to help you along... Did you ever notice a bangaa standing watch in front of a building in the North End? It might be worth your time to pay him a visit. Show him the clan primer I gave you. He'll let you inside. As for what's there...you'll just have to go see for yourself. / Oh, I hear you stopped by the clan hall. You're one shrewd customer. I'm sure you heard all manner of things from the other hunters, but just take your time to ease into it and you'll do fine. / Hi, Vaan. Something I can help you with? (choices: Tell me about marks. / Tell me about licenses. / No, thanks.) / Marks are monsters that a petitioner posts a bill to have hunted. Successfully hunting marks will earn you a small bounty. See that notice board over on the wall? That's where you can go to see what bills have been posted. It all starts there. But just looking at the bill isn't enough. You have to go talk to the petitioner and accept the hunt before setting out. The bill will always tell you where to find the petitioner. Once you've accepted the hunt, you're ready to track down the mark using the information given to you by the petitioner. If you're able to defeat the mark, report back to the petitioner. That completes the hunt, and you should receive your bounty. Simple, right? The best way to learn is by doing. Hunt a few marks on your own and you'll have it down in no time. / Each and every battle-related ability has a license that entitles you to use it. Say you want to cast the white magick "Cure." You have to obtain the license for it first. The same is true of equipment. Even the most devastating weapon won't do you any good if you don't have the license to equip it. The licenses you have determine how you can fight, so think before you choose. / You'll never find that Rogue Tomato standing around in here. The Imperials have started locking down the gates for the parade, but you ought to be able to get out if you show them that writ I gave you. Just talk to the watch by the east gate in the Southern Plaza. You shouldn't have any trouble. / Hey, Vaan. Did you ever notice a bangaa standing watch in front of a building in the North End? It might be worth your time to pay him a visit. Show him the clan primer I gave you. He'll let you inside. As for what's there...you'll just have to go see for yourself. There's a guy there who'll set you straight. / Ah, Vaan. I meant to tell you: this isn't the only notice board you'll find. Most cities—even some villages—have their own board. The good news is, all of the notice boards have the same bills. So you can go to the closest board without worrying about checking them all.

speaker: Rimzat
line_text: Hha! I have been waiting for some time. You see, I am in need of assistance. Please, hear my words. I have been sent from Archadia to study the sandstorms of the Dalmasca Westersand, but the storms' violence makes such study...impossible. There is a place in the desert, at the end of a long trail that winds through the north. Mayhap you know it. That is the site of my study. But before the wrath of such a storm, I can do nothing. This is why I seek help. Will you help me? (choices: Sure, I'll help. / No, sorry.) / Aah, have you reconsidered my request? I'm still looking for help. There is a place in the desert, at the end of a long trail that winds through the north, where a sandstorm rages. It is the subject of my study. But before the wrath of such a storm, I can do nothing. I want you to assist me. Will you help me? (choices: Sure, I'll help. / No, sorry.) / I am sorry to hear that. I must confess, I am at a loss as to how to proceed... If you change your mind, I will be here. / Thank you, my friend! I have made no progress on my own. I would like you to start by gathering information within Rabanastre. My own inquiries have yielded little. There is one man who knows more than he will say. He sits atop the fountain in the plaza. He does not care for the Empire, so he will tell me nothing. Perhaps you will have better luck. I will be waiting to hear what you find. / Have you learned aught of the sandstorm in the Westersand? There is a man named Cotze, who sits atop the fountain in the plaza. He knows something of this, but when he learned I was from Archadia, he would say no more. Perhaps you will have better luck. / Did he speak with you? Good, good. Don't let me interrupt your search. / I do not believe it! / Well, we saw it with our own eyes. A strange sort of...egg. And it wasn't long before it hatched. / It kept growing, and growing—we were terrified. And now that I think about it, that's just about the time the sandstorms started getting worse. / Hm? Is that...is that a wind globe you've got there? That looks just like the one you used to have, Northon. / That's because it is. Let me have a look... / There. This should let you make your way through the storm. Now you just need to decide whether that's really what you want to be doin'. / Well, that's about it. I can't think of anything we might have left out. / After the help you've given me, it pains me to say, but I've been relieved of my commission to study the sandstorms. Lack of results, they said... I've nothing to give you by way of reward... Pray, keep the windvane instead. Mayhap you will learn the secret of the sandstorm where I could not... May your travels be safe.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Hey, try and keep it down, wouldya? / Penelo isn't around, is she? Out on a delivery, maybe?

speaker: Kytes
line_text: Nope, haven't seen her all day. Not like her to up and skip out on work like that. / Migelo's not here either. He went running off somewhere a little while ago.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: So much for my big welcome. Guess everybody's busy.

speaker: Kytes
line_text: I got my hands full watching the shop... / and Old Dalan had something for me to do, but I can't get away.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Old Dalan, huh? / Tell you what. I'll go see him for you.

speaker: Kytes
line_text: Really?

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Well, nothing better to do.

speaker: Basch
line_text: So it was the Dawn Shard that brought down the Imperial fleet.

speaker: Balthier; Basch; Ashe
line_text: You know your stuff. / Destructive power of such force— I've seen it once before. / Lady Ashe, you know of what I speak. / Nabudis. / The capital of Old Nabradia— Lord Rasler's fatherland. / At the time of the invasion, a division of Imperials entered the city... There was a mighty explosion. Friend and foe died alike. / Something was there— one of the Dynast-King's relics. / The Midlight Shard was in Nabradia.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: More nethicite. Well, no wonder they invaded.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: That ridiculous war, the trap at the treaty-signing— all this because Vayne wanted power. / He must not be allowed to claim the nethicite. The Empire must never hold it.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Oh? They already do.

speaker: Balthier; Ashe
line_text: The Dusk Shard, most likely the Midlight Shard, too. / Besides, can't they manufact nethicite now? / Very well, then the path set before us is clear. We'll use the Dawn Shard to fight them!

speaker: Ashe
line_text: Dalmasca does not forget kindness nor ill deed done.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: With sword in hand she aids her allies. Sword in hand, she lays to rest her foes. / This nethicite I hold must be my sword. I will avenge those who have died. / And the Empire will know remorse.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: You even know how to use it?

speaker: Ashe; Fran
line_text: I— / The garif may know.

speaker: Fran
line_text: The garif people live by the old ways. Magicite lore is a part of their culture. / They may hear it. The cry of the nethicite's power. / Whispers of the Stone's menace.

speaker: Ashe; Fran
line_text: Dangerous though it be, what we need now is power. / Should we declare Dalmasca free without the means to defend our claim... / the Empire would crush us. / You must take me to meet with the garif. / They live beyond Ozmone Plain.

speaker: Balthier; Ashe
line_text: Not exactly close. / Compensation— is that what you want?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Straight to the point, aren't we. I like that. / Compensation? How about the ring.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: This? Isn't there something else?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: No one's forcing you.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: I'll give it back to you. As soon as I find something more valuable.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: What do you mean "something more valuable"?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Hard to say. I'll know when I find it.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: What is it you want, Vaan? What are you looking for?

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Me? What am I looking for? I guess—well, I—you know...

speaker: no name shown; system message
line_text: (empty string) / [value] and [value] join the party! (the game fills the two [value] with Balthier, party table row 3, and Fran, party table row 2)

speaker: Balthier; Migelo; Vaan; Fran; Basch; no name shown
line_text: As I said, a misunderstanding. / Misunderstanding!? What I am understanding is they took Penelo because of you! / What? What about Penelo? / Oh, Vaan! They've taken Penelo! / And there was a note— a note for this Balthier! / Come to the Bhujerba mines, it said. / It's Ba'Gamnan. He was in Nalbina. / If anything were to happen to that sweet child— why, I've her parents' memory to consider! / You're going to go to her aid, and that's that! It's what you sky pirates do, isn't it? / I don't respond well to orders. / You do know that the Imperial fleet is massing at Bhujerba? / Fine, then I'll go! / You at least have an airship, don't you? / Just get me there, and I'll find Penelo myself. / I'll join you. / I have some business there as well. / An audience with the Marquis, by chance? / Balthier, just take us and this is yours. / The gods are toying with us. / Make yourselves ready. We leave soon. / Right!

speaker: Vaan
line_text: There you are, Kytes. Stop loafing around!

speaker: Vaan
line_text: "Creature spotted in the Estersand." What is that thing?

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Welcoming? We should be—Ah, whatever. Say, Tomaj, what's this?

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Now that's work. Sounds ten times better than running errands for Migelo.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: And you should be getting back to Migelo. Now, Kytes. He was waiting for you.

speaker: Tomaj
line_text: Ah, Vaan. Migelo send you, too, did he?

speaker: Tomaj
line_text: He's a busy man these days, that Migelo, if I dare say so myself. / I don't envy him the work, though. Not a bit. / Quite the affair, throwing a banquet to welcome the Imperials, eh?

speaker: Tomaj
line_text: Ah, don't remind me.

speaker: Tomaj
line_text: Got some nastiness out there in the Estersand what's stopping our couriers... / and that means shortages all around. Thought I'd put up a bill... / offer a reward to anyone who can knock that nasty back in its place.

speaker: Kytes
line_text: Look, Vaan, look! This is it! / This is why Migelo's courier didn't get here on time!

speaker: Kytes
line_text: That's right! Vaan, you should give it a shot!

speaker: Kytes
line_text: Oh! Right, right.

line_text: I thank you.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: I'd avoid crowds, if I were you. In this town you're still a traitor, you know.

speaker: Basch
line_text: The Resistance will surely find me soon.

trigger: requested by AD.カット３_EASTGATE_ad, AD.カット３_SOUTHGATE_ad, AD.カット３_WESTGATE_ad
speaker: Basch
line_text: Fates will we meet again. I would pay my respects to your brother.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: You're a fugitive now, too. Stay low for a while.

trigger: requested by AD.カット６_EASTGATE_ad, AD.カット６_SOUTHGATE_ad, AD.カット６_WESTGATE_ad
speaker: Vaan
line_text: What about the stone?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Do as you like. That stone's ill-favored.

speaker: Fran
line_text: We feel regret. We sought that stone and found ourselves only worry.

trigger: requested by AD.カット７_EASTGATE_ad, AD.カット７_SOUTHGATE_ad, AD.カット７_WESTGATE_ad
speaker: Balthier
line_text: You offering it?

speaker: Vaan
line_text: It's mine!

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Then why do you ask? Our regards to your girl.

speaker: Fran
line_text: We stay in Rabanastre a while.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: What do you think? Can I trust Basch? / I gotta get rid of this thing.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: But maybe I should show it to Penelo first. So she knows I got something. / She'd be at Migelo's place this time of day.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Wait a second!

speaker: Vaan
line_text: How come you let these chocobos through the gate and not us?

speaker: Imperial
line_text: What of it?

speaker: Imperial
line_text: This here is a pedigreed parader, boy.

speaker: EslB (script label)
line_text: Cost tens of thousands of gil, this one did.

speaker: EslB (script label)
line_text: A prettier price than a hundred of you provincials would fetch.

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Keep your distance!

speaker: no name shown
line_text: We don't want the chocobos stinking of peasant.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: What did you say?

speaker: Imperial
line_text: Step aside!

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Right then, move 'em in.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: That does it.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: Ho ho! A fine, fine chocobo you have there.

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Yes! Tchita Downs stock, if I'm not mistaken.

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Change the soil, change the chocobo. Am I right?

speaker: Migelo
line_text: Yes, yes.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: Different soil means different bouquet, too.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: Take a Dalmascan Barose wine, eh?

speaker: Migelo
line_text: It may lack the flavor and depth of some of your Archadian wines...

speaker: Migelo
line_text: but it has a certain strength of character.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: It's not bad, really, once you get used to it.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: Care for some, sirs?

speaker: Migelo
line_text: There's more than enough for all to cool their throats, of course.

speaker: Imperial
line_text: You, let these carts through then we close this gate as ordered.

speaker: Imperial
line_text: My mail's choked with this sand.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: Don't give me a scare like that.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: You're lucky that ended where it did.

speaker: Penelo
line_text: Right. Now's our chance to go through.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: Ah, the ceremony'll be starting soon.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: I'd best be hurrying.

speaker: Penelo
line_text: Okay, well—

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Vaan! Wait!

speaker: Penelo
line_text: What is it? Vaan?

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Stand back, there! Back!

speaker: no name shown
line_text: This gate's closed until the ceremony's over, do you hear?

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Now what?

speaker: Imperial
line_text: Open the gate!

speaker: Imperial
line_text: All right, out of the way!
Now, I'm expecting Doctor Cid. You may leave.

speaker: Vayne
line_text: Those decrepit, basking fools in Archades tie my hands, and look what happens! / I tell you, this country's obstinancy knows no bounds.

speaker: Gabranth
line_text: The insurgents in Rabanastre operate alone at present. / However, should they garner external support, the situation could worsen. / We have found the counter-Imperial elements in Bhujerba to be conspicuously well funded. / No doubt Marquis Ondore is behind this. / Ondore must be reined in.

speaker: Vayne
line_text: By the way, the Marquis has written us a letter. / He claims that he's recaptured our runaway. He's given him to Ghis.

speaker: Gabranth
line_text: He will die by my hand.

speaker: Vayne
line_text: Your fraternity is moving. / Ah, Ghis returns with Larsa. Tomorrow morning they will leave Bhujerba. / See him home safely, Gabranth.

speaker: Doctor Cid; Vayne
line_text: We must see the real thing to be sure. Nabudis taught us much! / Yes, it's well hidden. They'll be off chasing after shadows, the fools. / Ah, yes! The reins of History back in the hands of Man. / Hah, Vayne! You seem to be enjoying your job as consul. / I was kept waiting fully 2 years. What news of Archades? Our honored members of the Senate? / Hard at work as always, trying to find a dagger for your back.

speaker: Vayne
line_text: They are welcome to try.

speaker: 小隊長 (script label, squad leader); Vayne; no name shown
line_text: Is Rabanastre to your liking, my lord? / It is magnificent! / Take this cathedral, for instance. / Elegant, yet whimsical in its execution. / A stunning example of Galtean architecture. / I hope Lord Gramis might one day look upon it himself.

speaker: 小隊長 (script label, squad leader)
line_text: The patron of this evening's banquet, may it please Your Excellency.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: I am Migelo, Your Highness. / It is truly a profound honor to make the acquaintance... / of our future emperor, Highness.

speaker: Migelo; Vayne
line_text: The people of Rabanastre join me in welcoming— / That's enough of "Highness." / Though indeed I am our emperor's son, I am no prince. / Archadia's emperor is freely chosen by her people. / I am but an elected official and nothing more.

speaker: Migelo
line_text: I meant no disrespect.

speaker: Vayne; Migelo
line_text: Now that I think on it... / I would not have you address me as Lord Consul, for that matter. / Henceforth, I am a citizen of Rabanastre. / Why don't you call me Vayne? / Eh, I could not. That would not be right. / You are overly fond of formalities. / I've just the remedy for that. / Tonight you will join me, and we shall drink until you call me by name.

speaker: Vaan; Penelo
line_text: How can he stand to bow to him like that? / Vaan, you just do not get it, do you. / He's not doing it because he wants to.

speaker: Penelo
line_text: You know what would happen if he didn't?

speaker: Vaan; Penelo
line_text: I know. It's just— / So, what would you do different? / I don't know. / Well, I'd do something.

speaker: movie subtitle
line_text: We will have order! / I give you your new consul... / His Imperial Highness Lord Vayne Solidor... / Commandant of the Archadian Empire's Western Ar— / Your Excellency! / People of Rabanastre! / Is it with hatred you look upon your consul? / With hatred, you look upon the Empire? / - Spit on your Empire! - Go back to Archadia! / There was little point in asking. / But know this: I harbor no idle hopes of frustrating that hatred. / Nor shall I ask your fealty. / That is the due of your fallen king, and rightly so. / King Raminas loved his people. / Strove to bring you peace. His was a rule worthy of your devotion. / Even now, he remains among you, protecting you. / His ardor for the peace and weal of Dalmasca falters not. / I would ask only that you do your king honor. / Together, let us embrace the peace His Majesty would surely desire. / Two years now divide us from war's bitter end. / Yet still its shadow looms over all, stifling the infant peace. / A pall only you may cast off! / Achieve but this one thing... / and your hatred of me, and of the Empire, will grieve me not! / I will stand fast. I will endure your hatred, suffer your slings and arrows. / I will defend Dalmasca! / Here I will pay my debt! I swear it now! / Though King Raminas and Lady Ashe be gone, they stand ever at the side of their people. / In honoring peace... / you do honor to their memory, and to Dalmasca. / What I ask, I ask plain. My hopes now rest with you.
